checklist: Recognizable mature date palm (Phoenix dactylifera) at established catalogue rendering quality, not photorealism. Whole: a single unbranched trunk carrying a rosette of arching pinnate fronds at the apex, the lower fronds drooping below the crown base, no branches, no foliage on the trunk. Trunk: the trunk clothed in retained leaf bases in a spiral from the crown down (not yet expressed by the generator; assess what is drawn, never invent it). Base: the leaf-base pattern at close range (same caveat). Photographs establish species character; the independent spruce anchor establishes finish quality only, never morphology. Additional realism optional. Unassessable cells unknown.

owner_notes: Second revision (2026-09-23): the trunk organs (fn-110) are landed and in the dial table; dial ranges come from validated bounds (fn-113) and strides from the named gap (fn-114). The date cluster (fn-111) is not landed. Priorities in the owner's words: the crown must read as a palm's rosette of long arching pinnate fronds with the lowest fronds drooping; the fronds are far too thin and short today (leaflet size and frond length are the first dials); the trunk must be straight or gently leaning, never wavy, of near-constant diameter; nothing grows on the trunk. Reviewer: Opus (claude) through the Claude adapter twins, the owner's fallback of 2026-09-22 while the Codex-backed Astra reviewer is out of quota; uncalibrated on this model. Dial table: `spacing` (short-shoot spacing, the palm bears no short shoots, value 0) and `taper` (twig tip taper, the palm's 1.0 is outside the authored 0.05-0.6 and is where the owner wants the trunk) are left out because their current palm values fall outside their authored ranges (host, 2026-09-22).
